requirements.text: We are looking for a software engineer with a strong background in game engine/realtime development. As a realtime 3D specialist, you will work with Unreal Engine to further develop our simulation capabilities for virtual environments for autonomous vehicles. This role will focus on bridging our core simulation engine with the game engine as well as developing new gameplay type features within Unreal. At Applied, we encourage all engineers to take ownership over technical and product decisions, closely interact with users to collect feedback, and contribute to a thoughtful, dynamic team culture.
Has 3+ years experience in developing and maintaining game engines at an AAA game studio
Has a bachelor's degree or higher. in a technical field such as computer design, graphics, game development or adjacent fields.
Has a background in deploying and optimizing software on multiple platforms (on-prem/cloud)
Is an expert in best practices for game engine architecture for scalability and flexibility
Is familiar with both Unreal and Content workflows
Prior experience in shipping Unreal Engine games
Prior work in either autonomous vehicles or simulation products
Experienced with integrating third party physics libraries
Experience with Houdini or other DCC packages (Maya 3DS Max or Blender)
Experience with networking and multiplayer use cases.
